title: Korean Chicken Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Korean-style chicken bowl recipe with crispy chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a nutty brown rice.
instructions: 1. Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, Korean chili flakes, garlic, and sesame oil.
4. Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat.
5. Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
6. Remove the chicken from the marinade and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. While the chicken is cooking, toast the sesame seeds in a pan over medium heat.
8. Chop the green onions and set aside.
9. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of brown rice in the bottom.
10. Top the rice with the baked chicken, toasted sesame seeds, and chopped green onions.
11. Drizzle with the remaining marinade and sprinkle with crushed red pepper flakes.
